attacker_pocs.name: pfr_three_pairs
attacker_pocs.cmd: cmake -S . -B build-asan -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer' -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address' -DFT_DISABLE_HARFBUZZ=ON -DFT_DISABLE_BROTLI=ON -DFT_DISABLE_BZIP2=ON -DFT_DISABLE_PNG=ON -DFT_DISABLE_ZLIB=ON >/tmp/pfr-poc-config.log && cmake --build build-asan -j4 >/tmp/pfr-poc-build.log && gcc -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -Iinclude -Ibuild-asan/include pocs/residual.c build-asan/libfreetyped.a -lm -o /tmp/pfr-residual && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/pfr-residual
attacker_pocs.why: A valid three-pair PFR kerning item uses one-byte character codes and one-byte adjustments. The final-pair lookup advances the binary-search base past the current item in the shipped branch, then reads beyond the nine-byte frame. The upstream fix bases the search at the current item for this layout.

role_a_rationale: The commit corrects the base adjustment for two-byte character codes and two-byte adjustments, which is a small maintenance repair in the affected search. It leaves the one-byte character-code, one-byte-adjustment branch advancing to the next item. A documented FT_Open_Face custom stream exposes an exact-size frame, so the residual over-read is caught by AddressSanitizer; the upstream patch returns kerning value 3 for the same font.
